{{Top|leg}}
The '''mobile command post''' was a prefabricated building developed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] for instances when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] needed a temporary presence on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] before an Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] arrived. The structure was built in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and towed to its destination.
